topic: Exploring Dimensional Shifts: From Flatland to 3D Geometry Puzzles
target_audience: High school students interested in geometry and spatial reasoning

sections.title: Prerequisite: The Concept of Projections (1 Minute)
lecture_lines: Objects cast shadows, revealing their shape.
This is the key to dimensional puzzles.
animations: Create a 3D cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] in the center using color #FFFFFF.
Project a shadow of the cube onto a 2D plane #FFFF00.
Rotate the cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] to show changing shadow dimensions #00FFFF.

sections.title: The Geometry of Flattening: Cross-Sections (1.5 Minutes)
lecture_lines: Slicing a 3D object reveals interior structure.
A sphere becomes a circle when sliced.
Slices change as they pass through.
We can infer volume from 2D slices.
Interior geometry is hidden in plain sight.
animations: Display a 3D sphere [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg] #FFFFFF in the center.
Animate a plane #FF00FF slicing through the sphere [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].
Show the resulting circular cross-section #00FF00 of the sphere [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/sphere.svg].

sections.title: Folding and Unfolding: Net Geometry (1.5 Minutes)
lecture_lines: 3D surfaces can be unfolded into nets.
Nets show how edges connect together.
animations: Visualize a 3D cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] #FFFFFF with unfolded sides.
Animate the sides folding into the 3D form #FFFF00.
Display the finished cube [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] with highlighted edges #00FFFF.

sections.title: Application: The Dimensional Shift Puzzle (1 Minute)
animations: Show a 2D square [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] #FFFFFF transitioning to a 3D cube #FFFF00.
Illustrate the 'Dimensional Shift' effect with scaling #00FF00.
Present the completed 3D object [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/cube.svg] with rotation #FF00FF.
